items.why: Truist raised its price target to $1,000 from $763, citing Meta's Muse AI push ahead of Oct 21 earnings, and Pivotal raised its target to $930. Momentum from the Muse Wonder model launch carried into Tuesday.
Volatility ticked up as stocks fell after a bank earnings deluge and AI spending worries hit chipmakers.
Shares slipped as investors await next week's earnings on Oct. 21, with focus on EV demand, robotaxi progress, and margins.
Microsoft is rolling out new AI chips designed to reduce dependence on pricey Nvidia chips, which has lifted shares.

market_note: Futures are slightly lower with the Nasdaq future down about half a percent and the VIX higher.
summary: Stocks are slipping Tuesday as bank earnings and AI spending worries weigh on chipmakers. Meta is bucking the down tape on AI optimism.
